The fix is pure comment rewrite plus two `it` titles, zero behavior, with an established method to copy (#3666: history + current-state two-paragraph rewrite in an isolated commit). Cheap, mechanical, and it rots further with every routing change — holding it has negative interest.

**Dedup**: #3712/#3738 are ROADMAP-side truth drift (different files); the sidebar/QuickActions-still-on-legacy-alias question is explicitly out of this card (filed separately per its body). No open duplicate.
